name: federicosella-site-tests
description: Test harness for the Hugo site (the site itself needs no npm). Run against a local build in public/, never against production.

scripts.test: node tests/static-checks.mjs && node --test "tests/unit/*.test.mjs" && node tests/functional.mjs && node tests/tool-pages.mjs && node tests/visual.mjs --no-shots && node tests/ads.mjs
